ProjectItems.project1Title: Interactive Photo Gallery — Unsplash REST API Integration
ProjectItems.project1Desc: A responsive image gallery built with Vanilla JavaScript and the Unsplash REST API. It features real-time search, category filters, and an accessible fullscreen lightbox with complete keyboard navigation and click-outside dismissal.

ProjectItems.project2Desc: A modern, responsive food ordering application built with React and Vite, featuring meal browsing, cart management, user authentication, and an account dashboard to review and track orders.
